shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin topped $72K, and Ethereum rocketed 20% past $2,300 today amidst significant short liquidations.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index shifted to 73 ("Greed") overnight, reflecting strong investor optimism.
The US Treasury announced increased long-dated bond buybacks, which has buoyed risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
President Trump urged Congress to pass the CLARITY Act, fostering regulatory optimism for the crypto industry.
